name: South Side Soapbox Plant (method / Ecover) - Chicago IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate or checkpoint pinch-point observed. The truck driveway runs open from the public road into the dock yard; the building fronts open paved drives with no controlled entry. truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on the site. False.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — there is no gate, so no remote check-in implied.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck yard north-east of the building provides interior holding space before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Open NE truck yard is deep — easily holds 3+ trucks staged.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Abundant unused paved width in the NE truck yard; ample room for any lane configuration.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Truck docks on the NE building face — a modest recessed dock bank with trailers backed in. ~16 doors estimated, banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Rows of parked trailers in the NE truck yard (some shared with adjacent Pullman-development buildings); banded 10-25 for the method-attributable portion.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock bank on one building face; shipping and receiving not physically separated.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One building (the 150,000 sq ft soap factory, which incorporates the Gotham Greens rooftop greenhouse). buildingCount 1.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the west edge of the property but it is a through line / neighbor siding, not a spur into the method property. railServed false (flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the City of Chicago (Pullman neighborhood); Urban despite the on-site restored prairie.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Per published facility data the site is 22 acres, of which only ~3.5 acres are developed (building + pavement) and the rest is restored natural prairie. Perimeter box approximates the developed/usable portion.
